hops fg preview accounts422978 --version 1 --online --n 500 --json 2>&1 > .tmp/online2.json
echo "total: $(grep -c '"row_id"' .tmp/online2.json)  distinct: $(grep '"row_id"' .tmp/online2.json | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ')  dupes: $(grep '"row_id"' .tmp/online2.json | sort | uniq -d | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

  echo "--- $id ---"; grep -A3 "\"row_id\": \"$id\"" .tmp/online2.json | grep -E 'status|balance|updated_at'
done

tool_input.command:
# Expected: max updated_at per row_id from source
tail -q -n +2 data/batch_*.csv | awk -F, '{if($4>m[$1])m[$1]=$4} END{for(k in m)print k","m[k]}' | sort > .tmp/expected.csv
# Actual from online store: pair row_id with its updated_at
grep -E '"(row_id|updated_at)"' .tmp/online2.json | sed -E 's/.*: "?([^",]+)"?,?/\1/' | paste -d, - - | sort > .tmp/actual.csv
echo "expected keys: $(wc -l < .tmp/expected.csv | tr -d ' ')   actual keys: $(wc -l < .tmp/actual.csv | tr -d ' ')"
echo "=== differences (empty = perfect match of latest updated_at for ALL 400 keys) ==="
diff .tmp/expected.csv .tmp/actual.csv && echo "PERFECT MATCH: every row_id in online store holds its latest revision"
tool_input.description: Full verification: online store latest-per-key vs source max
